title: Work Journal suggestions: one summary per project per day, and update suggestions that rewrite its card
story: Work Journal suggestions now give each project one short summary a day instead of several lines. Once that summary is a card on the page, later work comes as an update showing the old text struck through above the new; Accept rewrites the card's text and Reject leaves it alone. A summary still waiting in the box is rewritten in place rather than doubled. This replaces the old 'a second line for separate work' rule and the 200-character limit.

checks.criterion: A later run for a project with a card gives an update, not a new card
checks.steps: On today's page accept a suggestion for project demo-shop, commit again in demo-shop, then click run now.
checks.expected: The box shows 'Updates your HH:MM demo-shop entry', the card's current text grey and struck through, and the new text below.

checks.criterion: Accept rewrites the card and keeps its time
checks.steps: From the update above, click the green tick.
checks.expected: The same card holds the new text with the same time, project chip and source tag; no card is added.

checks.steps: Click the red cross on an update, then run now with no new work.
checks.expected: The card is unchanged and the update does not come back that day.

checks.criterion: The person's own words are never overwritten
checks.steps: While an update waits, edit that card's text, then click Accept.
checks.expected: The card keeps the edit, and a red line says the entry changed since the update was suggested.

checks.criterion: A waiting summary is rewritten, never doubled
checks.steps: Leave a project's suggestion unaccepted, commit again in that project, then run now.
checks.expected: Still one suggestion for that project, with merged text.

checks.steps: Add a card with + Add entry, set its project to demo-shop, then run now after new demo-shop work.
checks.expected: A normal new suggestion, not an update.
